body.condition: For every \(x\in\mathcal X\), an almost-everywhere version of \(\mathbb E_P[Y\mid A=a,X=x]\) has a continuous extension \(\mu_x^P\) satisfying \(\left|\mu_x^P(t)-\sum_{j=0}^{\ell}(\mu_x^P)^{(j)}(s)(t-s)^j/j!\right|\leq L|t-s|^\beta\) for all \(s,t\in[0,1]\).

standard.name: Taylor-remainder formulation of Hölder outcome-regression smoothness
